# MatterDraft Studio

> MatterDraft Studio is a local-first desktop workspace in development for lawyers, advocates, chambers and legal teams preparing legal documents and indexed court bundles.

In development for Windows and macOS. Website examples use fictional data. The desktop app processes case files on the user’s device and keeps generated bundles there.

## Product

- [Product overview in Markdown](https://matterdraft.legal/index.md): Scope, intended workflows and limitations.
- [Product website](https://matterdraft.legal/): Public feature descriptions and interactive examples.
- [Early access](https://matterdraft.legal/#early-access): Current registration availability and terms of the early access offer.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://matterdraft.legal/privacy): How MatterDraft Studio keeps legal files on your device and handles account, early access and support information.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://matterdraft.legal/terms): Terms for using the MatterDraft website, account portal and desktop app.
- [Refund and Cancellation Policy](https://matterdraft.legal/refund-policy): How to cancel a subscription, report a billing error or request a refund you are entitled to.
